spec_match.rationale: The router's knobs mirror the real depthSensing session-init surface (usagePreference, dataFormatPreference, and the v139 depthType raw/smooth hint) with spec-consistent trade-off copy, but the page never exercises the API itself — XR-hardware-gated, with real probes delegated to the visible conformance panel.

interactive.rationale: Both selects drive the generated session-init snippet, the four-row rationale matrix, and the quantified bytes-per-frame and latency readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede promises exactly what the page does: use-case-driven recommendations plus a bandwidth estimate.

edge_cases.rationale: Device resolutions and format sizes vary the estimate, but there is no treatment of unsupported-preference fallback ordering or of sessions where depth-sensing is refused.

references.rationale: Links the feature page, both sibling concepts, the WebXR depth-sensing spec, and the ChromeStatus entry.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the real WebXR surface (navigator.xr, isSessionSupported, XRFrame.getDepthInformation, XRCPUDepthInformation, XRWebGLDepthInformation) and rendered 6 pass in this browser's panel.

runtime_evidence.rationale: REPAIRED THIS PASS: the page shipped with HTML entities (=>, <td>) inside the inline script — a raw-text SyntaxError that killed all interactivity (empty snippet, zero matrix rows, dead dropdowns), plus an emerald-on-emerald value cell. After the fix, a fresh headless-Chrome CDP run drove both selects (hit-test -> lazy; Vision Pro -> 600 KB), confirmed 4 matrix rows, ivory-on-emerald computed colors, zero console errors, and the full-page screenshot was read.

telemetry_health.rationale: No page-level showcaseTelemetry asserts; the pre-fix SyntaxError is exactly the class of failure an assert would have surfaced in production telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Shared variables throughout; the repaired best-value cells are --bg-ivory on --accent-emerald (~4.6:1), and stats/labels stay AA.

accessibility.rationale: Selects have aria-labels and the matrix has an aria-label, but the visible label elements lack for/id association and the recommendation region is not announced on change (no live region).

openQuestions.title: Announce recommendation updates and associate the visible labels
openQuestions.detail: Add for/id between the visible labels and their selects, and wrap the snippet/stat updates in a polite live region (or add a visually-hidden status line) so recommendation changes are perceivable to screen readers.

openQuestions.title: Add telemetry asserts so a dead inline script is caught by production telemetry
openQuestions.detail: A single showcaseTelemetry assert after render() (e.g. matrix row count === 4) would have flagged the shipped SyntaxError from real visitors. Add asserts for the render contract.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Programmatically associate labels and announce derived output changes without relying on vision.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: the fix pass was scoped to the demonstrated runtime breakage (script entities + contrast); the label/live-region improvements are filed as open questions rather than bundled into the repair.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless CDP run post-fix; screenshot read for legibility.

summary: Live-broken page (entity-corrupted inline script, SyntaxError, dead controls, invisible emerald-on-emerald cells) repaired in place with the smallest edits; full control sequence re-verified headlessly after reload with zero console errors. A11y association/live-region and telemetry asserts remain as open questions.
